rationale: packages/core/src/value.ts exports holdsNone and NoCssForm beside what it exported; fns' contrast splits into a shared form and an ambient one the registry holds under the same name. The call-to-export pairs and the registry derivation are unchanged. The root package.json moves its parseman pin to 0.61.3; the binding names, modules and exports jessFunctions projects are unchanged. The root package.json gains the bench:scss:real script, merged with dev. No dependency, export, binding name or module this contract covers changes. The equivalence test lists namespacing-mixin-reference, a fixture .jess cannot spell yet; the bindings it checks are unchanged. The conversion suite gained a pin that .less and its .jess print the same under math: always; it is a test of the existing conversion path, so the contract and its consumers do not change. A .scss module call that fails is now an error under every functionMode and a missing member is resolve/name-not-found, so the sass-list-map-functions and sass-selector-parse suites expect the errors where they expected the call written out; bindings and conversions are unchanged. The conversion suite gained round trip rows for a lone filter call; a form may now say its name is also a CSS filter, and a built-in's call name and export are unchanged. Less and Sass registries now hold one contrast, grayscale and invert each. The conversion suite gained rows for a lone filter name reading a variable on filter or backdrop-filter, which stays the CSS call through .jess.
